description: This file defines configuration options classes for Orleans streaming system, including lifecycle, pub/sub, and pulling agent options.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for managing the lifecycle of the Orleans streaming system, including run states and lifecycle stages.

classes.name: StreamPubSubOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for stream pub/sub behavior, including pub/sub type.

classes.name: StreamPullingAgentOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for stream pulling agents, including batch size, polling period, timeouts, and inactivity period.

methods.name: RunState
methods.description: Enumeration of well-known points in the streaming system's lifecycle.
